text:
Ayesha: Kicking off staggered canary for v2.5.0 — target 20% over 30m, change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Starting with APAC slice. /deploy release=v2.5.0 percent=5->20 slice=apac

deploy-bot: [02:00:05] Deploy queued and started: v2.5.0 -> canary 5% (APAC). CI checks passed. Dashboard: https://deploy.internal/r/3301234500

Diego: Noticed an uptick in 500s on APAC edge-proxy at ~02:03. small sample but trending.

Priya: Can you paste the error rate panel? want to see if it's proxy or model error.

Diego: https://grafana.internal/d/edge/apac-errors panel: errors 500s = 1.6% (baseline 0.2%) ; latency p95 = 310ms (baseline 140ms) :frowning:

product-ops: tagging CS. We should prep a short line for release notes if we pause.

Ayesha: Hold ramp if errors >1% or latency >250ms in APAC. @sre-oncall can you run a quick isolation?

sre-oncall: Running `./ops/quick_isolate --region=apac --since=2m` now. Also checking infra deploys for last 30m.

sre-oncall: quick_isolate result: edge proxy pods restarting on APAC-a cluster, probably unrelated to model but causing upstream 502s. Recommend pin APAC to v2.4.9 and divert traffic to stable pool while infra fixes.

deploy-bot: [02:06:30] Canary ramp paused per operator request. Current canary APAC = 12%. Initiating region pin hold command.

Ayesha: @deploy-bot apply-pin region=apac version=v2.4.9 reason="edge proxy instability causing upstream 5xx"

deploy-bot: [02:06:37] Pin applied: APAC pinned to v2.4.9. Global canary remains at 12% excluding APAC. No automatic rollback executed.

Priya: QA: we'll run a focused regression against v2.5.0 in an apac-like env once infra is stable. ETA ~50m.

Diego: Infra team alerted; they rolled a proxy fix at 02:12. I'll watch for pod restarts and notify when stable.

product-ops: Draft release note line: "APAC slice paused at 12% due to upstream proxy instability; pinned to v2.4.9 while infra remediation completes." Adding to draft: https://docs.internal/releases/v2.5.0-draft

sre-oncall: Observability check: post-fix pod restarts stopped at 02:15. Metrics returning to baseline. Recommend re-evaluating canary after QA signoff.

Ayesha: Plan: wait for QA run + 2 green cycles, then a controlled unpin/resume of APAC. If we don't get green in 60m we schedule an automated rollback at 03:00 UTC for APAC.

Priya: Acknowledged. Will update QA run status here.

Diego: Filing INC-4021 and adding links/logs.

deploy-bot: [02:15:30] Reminder: Change window ends 03:00 UTC. Use `/deploy resume` to continue; automated rollback timer set for 03:00 if unresolved.
